name: SwiftXR (3D/AR/VR) Viewer
author: SwiftXR

sections.description:
Help visitors understand your products and ideas through interactive experiences. SwiftXR adds 3D, augmented reality (AR) and virtual reality (VR) to WordPress pages, posts, widgets and WooCommerce product pages. Visitors can rotate and zoom models, explore colour options, preview products in their space or enter Web VR.

Create and publish an experience in SwiftXR, then add it to your site with a shortcode or connect it directly to a WooCommerce product. Set the viewer size and choose its position on the product page from the plugin dashboard.

Build with the SwiftXR visual editor, or use SwiftXR Assistant to refine lighting, camera angles and other scene settings through conversation. Upload your own 3D models, choose from the built-in library or generate a model from a product image. Published experiences are responsive and work in modern desktop and mobile browsers.

Use SwiftXR analytics to track views, engagement and visitor actions. AI tools, advanced analytics and branding options depend on your SwiftXR plan.

Features

  • WooCommerce integration – Connect a published SwiftXR experience to a product and choose where the viewer appears.
  • Shortcode embedding – Add an experience to pages, posts, widgets and compatible page builders.
  • Interactive 3D, AR and Web VR – Let visitors inspect products and preview them in their environment.
  • Visual editor and SwiftXR Assistant – Customise scenes visually or refine them through conversation.
  • Flexible 3D content – Upload supported models, choose from the library or generate a model from an image.
  • Built-in analytics – See views, engaged visits and visitor actions in the SwiftXR dashboard.

Learn more at https://home.swiftxr.io/

External Service

This plugin connects your site to SwiftXR, a hosted service used to create, host and publish the 3D, AR and VR experiences embedded by the plugin. A SwiftXR account is required to create and publish a project.

When you add a published SwiftXR project URL, the plugin stores that URL and the viewer settings on your WordPress site. On the public page, the embedded viewer loads the published experience and its assets from SwiftXR. SwiftXR also processes the requests and interaction data needed to deliver the experience and provide analytics.

  • Service: https://home.swiftxr.io/
  • Terms of Service: https://swiftxr-wiki.notion.site/SwiftXR-Terms-of-Service-1ddd5d12803980f8bd23c9665ffb2a57
  • Privacy Policy: https://swiftxr-wiki.notion.site/SwiftXR-Privacy-Policy-1c9d5d128039800ba887eb94682e47d2
sections.installation:
1. Install SwiftXR from the WordPress Plugins screen, or upload the swiftxr-3darvr-viewer folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Create and publish a project in SwiftXR.
  4. Open SwiftXR Viewer > Add New Entry, paste the published project URL and save the entry.
  5. For a page, post or widget, copy the generated shortcode into a Shortcode block. For WooCommerce, switch to WooCommerce mode and select the product.
  6. Open the live page and confirm that the 3D viewer and AR button work as expected.
sections.faq:
What 3D file formats does SwiftXR support?

SwiftXR supports GLB, GLTF, FBX, OBJ and STL files.

What if I do not have a 3D model?

You can choose a model from the SwiftXR library or generate one from a product image. Availability and usage limits depend on your SwiftXR plan.

Can I use SwiftXR with Elementor?

Yes. Add Elementor’s Shortcode widget to the page and paste the shortcode generated by the SwiftXR Viewer plugin.

How do I add an experience to a WooCommerce product?

Create an entry in the SwiftXR Viewer dashboard, switch it to WooCommerce mode, select the product and save. You can choose the viewer position and height in the plugin settings.

Is a SwiftXR account required?

Yes. A SwiftXR account is required to create, host and publish the experience that this plugin embeds.

How can I get support?

Email support@swiftxr.io or use the support forum on this plugin page.
